name: g
description: Manage Git and GitHub work from commits and issue triage through reviewed pull-request delivery, with active-session audits.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Git and GitHub work from issues to reviewed pull requests.
interface.longDescription: G bundles focused Git and GitHub workflows for commits, issue lifecycle, repository triage, investigations, Actions failures, review threads, releases, stars, stacked pull requests, draft pull-request delivery, and read-only active-session audits. It uses direct Git for local work, the GitHub connector for supported remote operations, and gh only for connector gaps and the explicit gh-stack wrapper.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repository's open issues and pull requests.
Diagnose and fix the failing GitHub Actions checks.
Publish these local changes as a safe draft pull request.
Audit active Codex tasks using G skills and prioritize feedback, bugs, and improvements.
